## Introduction

The objective of this document is to explore the current state of indicators on political stringency in France.  


### Calculated indicators 

```{r}
#| label: setup
devtools::load_all()

ref_folder <- here::here("data", "derived-data", "ref")
ind_folder <- here::here("data", "derived-data", "indicators_csv")

# load shapefile
commune <- terra::vect(file.path(ref_folder, "commune_2154.gpkg"))
# load merged indicators
outC <- read.csv(file.path(ind_folder, "Dataset_commune.csv"))

# load shapefile
mailles <- terra::vect(file.path(ref_folder, "mailles_10km_2154.gpkg"))

# load merged indicators
outM <- read.csv(file.path(ind_folder, "Dataset_maille.csv"))

# add Paul data

# )
# m0 <- match(outC$INSEE_COM, paul_db$INSEE_COM)
# # table(is.na(m0)) # there are 3135 commune missing
# # select the interesting column
# keep <- 12:ncol(paul_db)
# # add them to outC
# outC[names(paul_db)[keep]] <- paul_db[m0, keep]
```


```{r}
#| label: metadata
meta <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  here::here("data", "derived-data", "megatrends_metadata.xlsx")
)
ps_crit <- grepl("stringency", meta$Megatrend)
ind_crit <- meta$Indicator == "yes"
colC <- c(
  "Name",
  "Description",
  "Year",
  "Unit",
  "Source"
)
ps <- meta[ps_crit & ind_crit, colC]
knitr::kable(ps)
```

Full indicator tables is stored in [Github](https://github.com/rfrelat/megatrends/blob/main/progress/megatrends_RF.xlsx)


## Overall correlation

::: {.panel-tabset}

## commune

```{r}
#| label: fig-corr-commune
#| fig-cap: "Correlation among megatrends per commune"
indC <- outC[, ps$Name[ps$Name != "CROP_DOMINANT_2023"]]

names(indC) <- sapply(strsplit(names(indC), "_"), function(x) {
  paste(x[1], x[2], sep = "\n")
})
pairs(indC, lower.panel = panel.smooth, upper.panel = panel.cor)
```

## maille

```{r}
#| label: fig-corr-maille
#| fig-cap: "Correlation among megatrends per maille"
indM <- outM[, ps$Name[ps$Name != "CROP_DOMINANT_2023"]]

names(indM) <- sapply(strsplit(names(indM), "_"), function(x) {
  paste(x[1], x[2], sep = "\n")
})
pairs(indM, lower.panel = panel.smooth, upper.panel = panel.cor)
```

::: 


## Missing data


```{r}
#| label: tbl-numberba
#| tbl-cap: "Number of NAs per variable and per spatial resolution"
naC <- apply(is.na(outC[, ps$Name]), 2, sum)
naM <- apply(is.na(outM[, ps$Name]), 2, sum)

nna <- data.frame(
  "NAs_Commune" = naC,
  "NA_perc_Commune" = round(naC / nrow(outC) * 100, 1),
  "NAs_Maille" = naM,
  "NA_perc_Maille" = round(naM / nrow(outM) * 100, 1)
)
knitr::kable(nna)
```
